newsitem.title: USA: PaineWebber takes $100 mln Mass. transport notes.
newsitem.headline: PaineWebber takes $100 mln Mass. transport notes.

text.p: PaineWebber Inc won $100 million of Massachusetts Bay Transportation Authority's $165 notes, all of which carry 4.50 percent coupons.
The firm won $50 million at a net interest cost of 3.64133 percent and $50 million at 3.6603 percent.
BayBank won $10 million at 3.6398 percent. Bear Stearns & Co won $25 million at 3.65236 percent and $25 million at 3.6694 percent. Finally, Tucker Anthony won $5 million 3.665 percent.
